name: Inverted Row
description: Pull the chest toward a fixed bar while the heels remain on the floor.

items.content: Use a securely fixed bar and grip just wider than shoulder width.
Hang beneath the bar with straight arms, heels grounded, and trunk braced.
Pull the chest toward the bar while keeping the hips in line with the shoulders and heels.
Lower slowly without swinging; use a higher bar for an easier body angle.

stages.name: Bottom
stages.description: Body beneath a fixed bar with arms straight and heels on the floor. Head, hips and heels align in a straight diagonal line.

stages.name: Top
stages.description: Chest close to the fixed bar, elbows bent beside the body and heels on the floor. Head, hips and heels remain aligned.
